SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-09-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-23-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF OLIVER BELANGER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT PETER HAU IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $480 TO THE PLAINTIFF, TENDERED IN COURT BY CHECK. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE AUG-23RD HEARING IF THE CHECK DOES NOT CLEAR. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
